scripts.cy:open: cross-env-shell CYPRESS_TEST_ENV=$ENV CYPRESS_TARGET=$TARGET CYPRESS_grepTags=$TAGS cypress open
scripts.cy:run: export REPORT_RUN_ID=${REPORT_RUN_ID:-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)} && export REPORT_DIR=reports/runs/$REPORT_RUN_ID && npm run report:clean && cross-env-shell CYPRESS_TEST_ENV=$ENV CYPRESS_TARGET=$TARGET CYPRESS_grepTags=$TAGS REPORT_DIR=$REPORT_DIR node --experimental-specifier-resolution=node --loader ts-node/esm scripts/run-cypress.ts run --spec "${SPEC:-cypress/e2e/**/*.cy.ts}" --record false --browser chrome
scripts.cy:debug: cross-env-shell DEBUG=cypress:* CYPRESS_TEST_ENV=$ENV CYPRESS_TARGET=$TARGET CYPRESS_grepTags=$TAGS node --experimental-specifier-resolution=node --loader ts-node/esm scripts/run-cypress.ts run --spec "${SPEC:-cypress/e2e/**/*.cy.ts}" --record false --browser chrome 2>&1 | tee console_output.txt
scripts.cy:record: cross-env-shell CYPRESS_TEST_ENV=$ENV CYPRESS_TARGET=$TARGET CYPRESS_grepTags=$TAGS node --experimental-specifier-resolution=node --loader ts-node/esm scripts/run-cypress.ts run --spec "${SPEC:-cypress/e2e/**/*.cy.ts}" --record --browser chrome
scripts.test:smoke: cross-env-shell CYPRESS_TEST_ENV=$ENV CYPRESS_TARGET=$TARGET CYPRESS_grepTags=$TAGS node --experimental-specifier-resolution=node --loader ts-node/esm scripts/run-cypress.ts run --spec 'cypress/e2e/smoke/**/*.cy.ts' --record --browser chrome --group smoke --parallel
scripts.test:navigation: cross-env-shell CYPRESS_TEST_ENV=$ENV CYPRESS_TARGET=$TARGET CYPRESS_grepTags=$TAGS node --experimental-specifier-resolution=node --loader ts-node/esm scripts/run-cypress.ts run --spec 'cypress/e2e/navigation/**/*.cy.ts' --record --browser chrome --group navigation --parallel
scripts.test:spec: cross-env-shell CYPRESS_TEST_ENV=$ENV CYPRESS_TARGET=$TARGET CYPRESS_grepTags=$TAGS node --experimental-specifier-resolution=node --loader ts-node/esm scripts/run-cypress.ts run --spec "$SPEC" --record --browser chrome --group ${GROUP:-spec} --parallel
scripts.test:all: export REPORT_RUN_ID=${REPORT_RUN_ID:-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)} && export REPORT_DIR=reports/runs/$REPORT_RUN_ID && npm run report:clean && cross-env-shell CYPRESS_TEST_ENV=$ENV CYPRESS_TARGET=$TARGET CYPRESS_grepTags=$TAGS REPORT_DIR=$REPORT_DIR node --experimental-specifier-resolution=node --loader ts-node/esm scripts/run-cypress.ts run --spec "cypress/e2e/**/*.cy.ts" --record --browser chrome --group all --parallel
